name: South Dakota State Cross Country Championships
where: Rapid City, SD · Hart Ranch Camping Resort
headline: South Dakota State Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Harrisburg's Brianna Reilly repeated as Class AA girls champion in 17:06.5, leading a 1-2 with teammate Hannah Genrich (17:20.5) as No. 18 Harrisburg won the team title with 41 points to Sioux Falls Lincoln's 71; Spearfish's Peyton VanDeest was fourth in 17:36.2. Sioux Falls Washington's Cole Reilly won the Class AA boys race in 14:53.9 and led Washington to the team title, 51 to Sioux Falls Lincoln's 81. Deubrook Area's Nora Olsen (18:27.3) and Mitchell Christian's Silas Holdeman (16:07.7) won the Class B races.
